description: Read a seller's negotiable terms by their public handle: which products are open to offers, at what list price and currency, how many offers a negotiation allows and how long a counter stands. Never the floor price. Pass product_id to narrow it to one product. Public: needs no credential. An unknown handle, a seller with offers off and a product that is off all answer not found.

handle.description: The seller's public handle, from the terms they publish.

product_id.description: The seller's id for the product.

name: get_offer_terms
